snippet.title: Break through the limit | The First Descendant: Breakthrough Trailer
snippet.description:
More expansive. More intense. The battlefield has evolved.
Pre-register now and be the first to dive into the Breakthrough Update!
👉 Pre-registration link: https://tfd.nexon.com/en/events/2025/06/preregister
Don’t miss the playable demo starting July 24!
 
PLAY FREE NOW: https://tfd.nexon.com/ 

The First Descendant is a next generation third-person co-op action RPG shooter (looter shooter) featuring high-quality graphics developed using Unreal Engine 5. It presents fun strategic boss fights through 4-player co-op, various unique characters, exciting gunplay, and looting.
